newsitem.title: GERMANY: Duisenberg-ESCB won't take orders from politicians.
newsitem.headline: Duisenberg-ESCB won't take orders from politicians.

text.p: Wim Duisenberg, president of the European Monetary Institute, said on Tuesday that the European System of Central Banks (ESCB) would not take orders from politicians in carrying out its task to maintain price stability.

"The ESCB is obliged by law to maintain price stability and without prejudice to this objective to support the general economic policy in the community," Duisenberg, who took over as president of the EMI -- the forerunner to the European Central Bank -- said in a statement during the Global 24 conference.
"And in doing so it shall not take any instructions from politicians or their staff."
